feet_e029._about: E029's foot-slip table as the paper showed it up to v0.10, frozen here (paper/collect.py read it from work/<name>/foot_audit.json, blender/foot_audit.py before metric v2, run 2026-09-25). Slip is the worse foot's contact speed divided by max(manifest speed, 1 m/s): understated below 1 m/s, so entries below 1 m/s were left out. Superseded by the v2 audit (true ground speed) in research/data/e130_planting.json.

aberration_controls.check: sink: floor every frame, lowest -3 cm
pop: popping at the popped frame only
bend: a fast smooth bend is not popping

unimate._about: E129: UniMate moves on Cadet's own skeleton (tools/unimate_moves.py; the bow from the Studio's Moves from words panel). Aberrations from work/cadet/qa/aberrations.json (DQS, every frame), the build of 2026-10-02; foot slip from blender/foot_audit.py (worse foot, m/s): before = the moves as first generated, planting switched off (2026-09-30), after = with the toe bone recovered and every vertex of the shoe planted (E130, 2026-10-02). Times measured 2026-09-30 on this Mac (M5, 24 GB).

moves.salute: An object stands at attention and salutes with its right hand raised to its forehead.
moves.ready: An object drops into a ready combat stance with both fists raised and looks left and right.
moves.fist_pump: An object pumps its right fist in the air in celebration.
moves.look_around: An object looks to the left and then to the right.

planting._about: E130: which surface of the shoe is planted. Roster: 13 characters x 9 gaits, blender/foot_audit.py metric v2 (slip of the worse foot as a share of the true ground speed), each build complete from the animate stage. before = a rigid copy of the sole (vertices within 3 cm of the floor, at most 160) carried on the ankle bone (2026-10-01 backups); thinned = the whole shoe below the ankle, posed by its own skin weights (DQS), thinned to 400 points (2026-10-01); after = every vertex of it (2026-10-02). Cadet (built after the first run) is reported on his own. variants = retargeting alone on the cases that regressed, the rest of the pipeline not run.
